    77	/-! ## The lambda-tied drop package -/
    78	
    79	section DropPackage
    80	
    81	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    82	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
    83	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
    84	
    85	/-- Data for the positive twist and the subsequent point subtraction.
    86	
    87	`hM₀` ties the splitting field presentation to the particular input `mu`; `hW₀` says that the
    88	divisor being reduced is in the positive twist class (the chart index is zero at this stage).
    89	`baseSubtraction` is intentionally an explicit class-level bridge: it says that the divisor
    90	returned by the greedy reduction is represented by a base-field divisor.  The current tree has
    91	the graph-class version of this bridge but no divisor pullback operation, so this hypothesis is
    92	kept visible rather than replaced by a fieldwise existential. -/
    93	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropData (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) where
    94	  m : ℕ
    95	  M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic
    96	  hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
    97	    PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀)
    98	  W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
    99	  hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   100	    M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   101	      (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor))
   102	  genusValue : ℕ
   103	  excess : ℕ
   104	  hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (genusValue : ℤ)
   105	  hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genusValue : ℤ) + excess
   106	  h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   107	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)
   108	  P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   109	  hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   110	    (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty
   111	  hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   112	  hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1
   113	  baseSubtraction : ∀ (S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor),
   114	    0 ≤ S → Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (excess : ℤ) →
   115	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   116	        coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) →
   117	      ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   118	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   119	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   120	            ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   121	
   122	/-- The output of the positive-twist/drop construction, tied to both the input class and the
   123	base-field translating divisor.
   124	
   125	The final field is the existing fibre consumer.  In particular, `S` is not merely a divisor
   126	with the right cohomology: `baseClass` identifies its class with the base change of `Z`, and
   127	`translated` is about `mu` translated by the resulting base-field class
   128	`chartTwistClass C d.m Z`. -/
   129	structure SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   130	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) where
   131	  S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor
   132	  Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor
   133	  nonnegative : 0 ≤ S
   134	  degree : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L S = (d.excess : ℤ)
   135	  support : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint _),
   136	    coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ d.P
   137	  baseClass : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   138	    Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹)
   139	  h0_one : Sheaf.h0
   140	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) = 1
   141	  h1_vanishing : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   142	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (d.W₀ - S)) 1)
   143	  translated : IsSplitWitness C
   144	    (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K))
   145	
   146	/-- Positive twisting followed by point subtraction produces the exact field-level translated
   147	rank-one witness.
   148	
   149	The greedy theorem supplies `S`, `h0 = 1`, and preservation of `H1 = 0`.  The explicit
   150	`baseSubtraction` bridge then supplies the base divisor `Z`; class arithmetic shows that
   151	`W₀ - S` presents `mu` translated by the base-field class `chartTwistClass C d.m Z`.  The last
   152	line applies the existing `IsSplitWitness` consumer, so no unrelated Picard class can satisfy
   153	the conclusion. -/
   154	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult
   155	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   156	    (d : SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ) :
   157	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ d) := by
   158	  obtain ⟨-, S, hS0, hSdeg, hSsupport, hS0one, hS1⟩ :=
   159	    exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop C μ d.m
   160	      (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   161	      d.genusValue d.excess d.hχ d.M₀ d.hM₀ d.W₀ d.hW₀ d.hdeg d.h1
   162	      d.P d.hdense d.hPcl d.hPdeg
   163	  obtain ⟨Z, hSZ⟩ := d.baseSubtraction S hS0 hSdeg hSsupport
   164	  have hW : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (d.W₀ - S) =
   165	      d.M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   166	        (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) := by
   167	    have hW₀ := d.hW₀
   168	    unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hW₀ hSZ ⊢
   169	    rw [sub_eq_add_neg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add, Scheme.picClass_neg,
   170	      hW₀, hSZ]
   171	    simp only [map_inv, inv_inv]
   172	    rw [mul_assoc, ← map_mul]
   173	    simp only [chartTwistClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, inv_one, mul_one,
   174	      pow_zero, one_mul]
   175	  have htranslated : IsSplitWitness C
   176	      (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C d.m Z) (overSpec k K)) :=
   177	    isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ d.m Z d.M₀ d.hM₀
   178	      (d.W₀ - S) hW hS1
   179	  exact ⟨{
   180	    S := S
   181	    Z := Z
   182	    nonnegative := hS0
   183	    degree := hSdeg
   184	    support := hSsupport
   185	    baseClass := hSZ
   186	    h0_one := hS0one
   187	    h1_vanishing := hS1
   188	    translated := htranslated
   189	  }⟩
   190	
   191	end DropPackage

     9	/-!
    10	# DAT-B B-1 — the oracle-parametrized greedy `h⁰`-drop to `h⁰ = 1`
    11	
    12	The coverage-side normalization of the DAT-B worksheet (`informal/w4-datb-worksheet.md`
    13	§1.4, COV-2): on the curve bundle `Y` over a field `K` (the fibre field of the coverage
    14	argument), given an **admissible point oracle** `P` — a set of closed `K`-rational points
    15	(`residueDeg = 1`) meeting every nonempty open — and a divisor `W` of degree `g + e` with
    16	`H¹(𝒪(W)) = 0`, there is an effective divisor `Σ` of degree `e` supported in `P` with
    17	
    18	  `h⁰(𝒪(W − Σ)) = 1`  and  `H¹(𝒪(W − Σ)) = 0`
    19	  (`exists_effective_sub_h0_eq_one`, the keystone).
    20	
    21	The pointwise coverage theorem (B-5, worksheet §1.2 step 5) consumes this with
    22	`P :=` the base-changed `C(K_s)`-points supplied by the density oracle of B-2
    23	(`Curve/SepPointsDense.lean`); the oracle parametrization decouples the density
    24	discharge from the pure Riemann–Roch drop.
    25	
    26	## Route (worksheet §1.4, per step for the current `W'` with `h¹ = 0`, `deg = g + e'`)
    27	
    28	* **The bad locus is small** (`exists_admissible_nonbase_point`): `H⁰(𝒪(W'))` is nonzero
    29	  (rank anchor `h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one`), its base divisor
    30	  (`Scheme.baseDivisor`, the DD-F kit) has finite support consisting of closed points, so
    31	  the non-base locus contains a nonempty open (complement of a finite closed set in the
    32	  irreducible curve — it contains the generic point) and the oracle supplies an admissible
    33	  point there; the base-divisor achiever (`exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt`) turns
    34	  "outside the support" into an exact-order section.
    35	* **Exact drop at a rational non-base point** (`h0_sub_single_of_rational_nonbase`):
    36	  `h⁰(𝒪(W' − x)) ≤ h⁰(𝒪(W')) − 1` — sections of `W' − x` are sections of `W'`, a *proper*
    37	  submodule since the non-base section violates the deeper pole bound at `x`
    38	  (`Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt` through the `h⁰` bridge
    39	  `finrank_divisorSections_top`) — while the χ-ledger (`chi_divisorSheaf`) with
    40	  `residueDeg x = 1` and `h¹(𝒪(W')) = 0` gives `χ(𝒪(W' − x)) = h⁰(𝒪(W')) − 1`; equality
    41	  forces BOTH `h⁰(𝒪(W' − x)) = h⁰(𝒪(W')) − 1` AND `h¹(𝒪(W' − x)) = 0` — the induction
    42	  invariant.
    43	* **Terminate at `e' = 0`**: `h⁰ = 1` by the rank anchor at `deg = g`, `χ(𝒪) = 1 − g`.
    44	
    45	The strict-drop precedents `h0_normalization_sub_single_lt` (`PFib.lean`) and
    46	`h0_window_sub_single_lt` (`CarveDegreePinch.lean`) are window-specific mirrors of the
    47	drop step (worksheet risk 3 mitigation); their `deg_single`/`coeffAt` bookkeeping is
    48	imitated, not consumed.  Pure field level — no scheme beyond the fibre curve appears
    49	(the DD-F discipline).  The genus enters only through `hχ : χ(𝒪_Y) = 1 − g`; the
    50	worksheet's standing `h⁰(𝒪_Y) = 1` is not needed by this brick and is not threaded.
    51	-/

    66	variable {K : Type u} [Field K] {Y : Scheme.{u}} [IsIntegral Y]
    67	  [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    68	  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    69	  [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]
    70	  [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))]

    74	/-! ## The bad locus is small: an admissible non-base point -/
    75	
    76	omit [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 0)]
    77	  [Module.Finite K (Sheaf.HModule (Y.moduleKSheaf K) 1)] in
    78	/-- **An admissible non-base point** (worksheet §1.4 bullet 1): if `H⁰(𝒪(W))` is nonzero
    79	and `P` is dense (meets every nonempty open) and consists of closed points, then some
    80	`x ∈ P` is *not* a base point of the system: some nonzero section `f ∈ H⁰(𝒪(W))` has
    81	exact order at `x`, `(W + div f)ₓ = 0`.  The base locus is contained in the support of
    82	the base divisor `bd(H⁰(𝒪(W)))` — a finite set of closed points, whose complement is a
    83	nonempty open (it contains the generic point); the base-divisor achiever
    84	(`Scheme.exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt`) realizes the vanishing base multiplicity
    85	outside the support. -/
    86	theorem exists_admissible_nonbase_point (P : Set Y)
    87	    (hdense : ∀ U : Y.Opens, (U : Set Y).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty)
    88	    (hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint Y)
    89	    (W : Y.CurveDivisor) (hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K W)) :
    90	    ∃ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) (_ : x ∈ P) (f : Y.functionField)
    91	      (_ : f ∈ divisorSections K W ⊤) (hf : f ≠ 0),
    92	      coeffAt hx (W + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))
    93	        = 0 := by
    94	  classical
    95	  set T : Submodule K Y.functionField := divisorSections K W ⊤ with hT
    96	  have hTne : ∃ f ∈ T, f ≠ 0 := by
    97	    refine Submodule.exists_mem_ne_zero_of_ne_bot (fun hbot => ?_)
    98	    have hfr : Module.finrank K ↥T = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K W) :=
    99	      finrank_divisorSections_top K W
   100	    rw [hbot, finrank_bot] at hfr
   101	    omega
   102	  set B : Y.CurveDivisor := Scheme.baseDivisor K T W hTne with hB
   103	  -- the support of the base divisor is a finite set of closed points
   104	  have hclosed : IsClosed (⋃ p ∈ (toFinsupp B).support, ({p.1} : Set Y)) :=
   105	    isClosed_biUnion_finset (fun p _ =>
   106	      isClosed_singleton_of_ne_genericPoint (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) p.2)
   107	  set U : Y.Opens :=
   108	    ⟨(⋃ p ∈ (toFinsupp B).support, ({p.1} : Set Y))ᶜ, hclosed.isOpen_compl⟩ with hU
   109	  have hUne : (U : Set Y).Nonempty := by
   110	    refine ⟨genericPoint Y, fun hmem => ?_⟩
   111	    obtain ⟨p, _, hp⟩ := Set.mem_iUnion₂.mp hmem
   112	    exact p.2 (Set.mem_singleton_iff.mp hp).symm
   113	  obtain ⟨x, hxP, hxU⟩ := hdense U hUne
   114	  have hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y := hPcl x hxP
   115	  -- outside the support the base multiplicity vanishes
   116	  have hxc : x ∉ ⋃ p ∈ (toFinsupp B).support, ({p.1} : Set Y) := hxU
   117	  have hxB : coeffAt hx B = 0 := by
   118	    by_contra hne
   119	    exact hxc (Set.mem_iUnion₂.mpr
   120	      ⟨⟨x, hx⟩, Finsupp.mem_support_iff.mpr hne, rfl⟩)
   121	  have hBat : (Scheme.baseDivisorAt K T W ⟨x, hx⟩ : ℤ) = 0 := by
   122	    rw [← Scheme.coeffAt_baseDivisor K hTne hx]
   123	    exact hxB
   124	  -- the achiever realizes the vanishing base multiplicity
   125	  obtain ⟨f, hfT, hf, hach⟩ :=
   126	    Scheme.exists_coeffAt_eq_baseDivisorAt K (le_refl T) hTne hx
   127	  exact ⟨x, hx, hxP, f, hfT, hf, hach.trans hBat⟩
   128	
   129	/-! ## The exact drop at a rational non-base point -/
   130	
   131	/-- **The exact drop** (worksheet §1.4 bullet 2): at a closed `K`-rational point `x`
   132	(`residueDeg x = 1`) that is not a base point of `H⁰(𝒪(W))` — witnessed by a nonzero
   133	section `f` of exact order at `x` — and under `H¹(𝒪(W)) = 0`,
   134	
   135	  `h⁰(𝒪(W − x)) + 1 = h⁰(𝒪(W))`  and  `H¹(𝒪(W − x)) = 0`.
   136	
   137	`≤`: sections of `W − x` are sections of `W` vanishing one order deeper at `x`, a proper
   138	subspace since `f` violates the deeper bound — one linear condition as `residueDeg x = 1`.
   139	`≥`: the χ-ledger gives `χ(𝒪(W − x)) = χ(𝒪(W)) − 1 = h⁰(𝒪(W)) − 1` and `h¹ ≥ 0`.
   140	Equality forces both conclusions — the induction invariant of the greedy drop. -/
   141	theorem h0_sub_single_of_rational_nonbase (W : Y.CurveDivisor)
   142	    (h1W : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1))
   143	    {x : Y} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y) (hdx : Y.residueDeg K x = 1)
   144	    {f : Y.functionField} (hfW : f ∈ divisorSections K W ⊤) (hf : f ≠ 0)
   145	    (hnb : coeffAt hx (W + Scheme.divOf (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K)) (Units.mk0 f hf))
   146	      = 0) :
   147	    Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) + 1
   148	        = Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K W) ∧
   149	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) 1) := by
   150	  -- sections of `W − x` sit inside sections of `W` …
   151	  have hle : divisorSections K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ⊤
   152	      ≤ divisorSections K W ⊤ := by
   153	    refine divisorSections_mono K ?_ ⊤
   154	    refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun y hy => ?_)
   155	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub]
   156	    by_cases hyx : y = x
   157	    · subst hyx
   158	      rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_self]
   159	      omega
   160	    · rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_of_ne hx hy hyx]
   161	      omega
   162	  -- … properly: the exact-order section violates the deeper bound at `x`
   163	  have hfnot : f ∉ divisorSections K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ⊤ := by
   164	    intro hmem
   165	    have h0le := (mem_divisorSections_top_iff K hf).mp hmem
   166	    have hcoeff := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp h0le x hx
   167	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_sub,
   168	      CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_self] at hcoeff
   169	    rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add] at hnb
   170	    omega
   171	  have hne : divisorSections K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) ⊤
   172	      ≠ divisorSections K W ⊤ := by
   173	    intro heq
   174	    rw [← heq] at hfW
   175	    exact hfnot hfW
   176	  have hdrop : Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
   177	      < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K W) := by
   178	    have hlt := Submodule.finrank_lt_finrank_of_lt (lt_of_le_of_ne hle hne)
   179	    rwa [finrank_divisorSections_top K _, finrank_divisorSections_top K _] at hlt
   180	  -- the χ-ledger on both levels
   181	  have hchiW := chi_divisorSheaf K W
   182	  have hchiWx := chi_divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   183	  have hdegsub : CurveDivisor.deg K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   184	      = CurveDivisor.deg K W - 1 := by
   185	    rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single' K hx 1, hdx,
   186	      Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
   187	  rw [hdegsub] at hchiWx
   188	  have hh0W : Sheaf.chi (Y.divisorSheaf K W) = (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K W) : ℤ) :=
   189	    Sheaf.chi_eq_h0 h1W
   190	  have hchidef : Sheaf.chi (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1))
   191	      = (Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) : ℤ)
   192	        - (Sheaf.h1 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) : ℤ) := rfl
   193	  have hh1 : Sheaf.h1 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)) = 0 := by omega
   194	  refine ⟨by omega, ?_⟩
   195	  haveI := moduleFinite_hModule_divisorSheaf_one K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   196	  exact Module.finrank_zero_iff.mp hh1
   197	
   198	/-! ## The keystone: the greedy drop to `h⁰ = 1` -/
   199	
   200	/-- **COV-2, the oracle-parametrized greedy `h⁰`-drop** (★ B-1 keystone, worksheet §1.4):
   201	on the curve bundle `Y` over the field `K` with `χ(𝒪_Y) = 1 − g`, let `P` be an
   202	admissible point oracle — closed points, `K`-rational (`residueDeg = 1`), dense (meeting
   203	every nonempty open).  Then every divisor `W` of degree `g + e` with `H¹(𝒪(W)) = 0`
   204	admits an effective divisor `Σ` of degree `e` supported in `P` with
   205	
   206	  `h⁰(𝒪(W − Σ)) = 1`  and  `H¹(𝒪(W − Σ)) = 0`.
   207	
   208	Induction on `e`: at each step the rank anchor gives `h⁰ = e' + 1 ≥ 1`, the oracle
   209	supplies a rational non-base point (`exists_admissible_nonbase_point`), and the exact
   210	drop (`h0_sub_single_of_rational_nonbase`) preserves the invariant `h¹ = 0` while
   211	lowering the degree budget by one.  The pointwise coverage theorem (B-5) instantiates
   212	`P` with the base-changed `C(K_s)`-points of B-2. -/
   213	theorem exists_effective_sub_h0_eq_one (g : ℕ)
   214	    (hχ : Sheaf.chi (Y.moduleKSheaf K) = 1 - (g : ℤ))
   215	    (P : Set Y)
   216	    (hdense : ∀ U : Y.Opens, (U : Set Y).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty)
   217	    (hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint Y)
   218	    (hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, Y.residueDeg K x = 1)
   219	    (W : Y.CurveDivisor) (e : ℕ)
   220	    (hdeg : CurveDivisor.deg K W = (g : ℤ) + e)
   221	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1)) :
   222	    ∃ S : Y.CurveDivisor, 0 ≤ S ∧ CurveDivisor.deg K S = (e : ℤ) ∧
   223	      (∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y), coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) ∧
   224	      Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - S)) = 1 ∧
   225	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - S)) 1) := by
   226	  suffices H : ∀ (e : ℕ) (W : Y.CurveDivisor),
   227	      CurveDivisor.deg K W = (g : ℤ) + e →
   228	      Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K W) 1) →
   229	      ∃ S : Y.CurveDivisor, 0 ≤ S ∧ CurveDivisor.deg K S = (e : ℤ) ∧
   230	        (∀ (x : Y) (hx : x ≠ genericPoint Y), coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) ∧
   231	        Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - S)) = 1 ∧
   232	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule (Y.divisorSheaf K (W - S)) 1) from
   233	    H e W hdeg h1
   234	  intro e
   235	  induction e with
   236	  | zero =>
   237	    intro W hdeg h1
   238	    have hanchor := h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one (K := K) W h1
   239	    rw [hχ, hdeg] at hanchor
   240	    refine ⟨0, le_refl 0, by rw [CurveDivisor.deg_zero, Nat.cast_zero], ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   241	    · intro x hx hne
   242	      exact (hne (CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero hx)).elim
   243	    · rw [sub_zero]
   244	      push_cast at hanchor
   245	      omega
   246	    · rw [sub_zero]
   247	      exact h1
   248	  | succ e ih =>
   249	    intro W hdeg h1
   250	    -- `h⁰(𝒪(W)) = e + 2 > 0` by the rank anchor
   251	    have hanchor := h0_eq_deg_add_chi_of_subsingleton_hModule_one (K := K) W h1
   252	    rw [hχ, hdeg] at hanchor
   253	    have hpos : 0 < Sheaf.h0 (Y.divisorSheaf K W) := by
   254	      push_cast at hanchor
   255	      omega
   256	    -- an admissible non-base point and the exact drop there
   257	    obtain ⟨x, hx, hxP, f, hfW, hf, hnb⟩ :=
   258	      exists_admissible_nonbase_point P hdense hPcl W hpos
   259	    obtain ⟨hdrop, h1'⟩ :=
   260	      h0_sub_single_of_rational_nonbase W h1 hx (hPdeg x hxP) hfW hf hnb
   261	    have hdeg' : CurveDivisor.deg K (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) = (g : ℤ) + e := by
   262	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_sub' K, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single' K hx 1,
   263	        hPdeg x hxP, Nat.cast_one, mul_one, hdeg]
   264	      push_cast
   265	      ring
   266	    obtain ⟨S', hS'0, hS'deg, hS'P, hS'h0, hS'h1⟩ :=
   267	      ih (W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1) hdeg' h1'
   268	    have hsplit : W - (S' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1)
   269	        = W - CurveDivisor.single hx 1 - S' := by
   270	      abel
   271	    refine ⟨S' + CurveDivisor.single hx 1, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
   272	    · -- effectivity
   273	      refine CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mpr (fun y hy => ?_)
   274	      have h0S' := CurveDivisor.le_iff_coeffAt.mp hS'0 y hy
   275	      rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero] at h0S'
   276	      rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_zero, CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add]
   277	      by_cases hyx : y = x
   278	      · subst hyx
   279	        rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_self]
   280	        omega
   281	      · rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_of_ne hx hy hyx]
   282	        omega
   283	    · -- degree
   284	      rw [CurveDivisor.deg_add, hS'deg, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single' K hx 1,
   285	        hPdeg x hxP, Nat.cast_one, mul_one]
   286	      push_cast
   287	      ring
   288	    · -- support in `P`
   289	      intro y hy hne
   290	      rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_add] at hne
   291	      by_cases hyx : y = x
   292	      · subst hyx
   293	        exact hxP
   294	      · rw [CurveDivisor.coeffAt_single_of_ne hx hy hyx, add_zero] at hne
   295	        exact hS'P y hy hne
   296	    · rw [hsplit]
   297	      exact hS'h0
   298	    · rw [hsplit]
   299	      exact hS'h1
   300

    13	# Rational-point residue bridge for the translated cover
    14	
    15	The density oracle used by the translated-cover drop has to record residue degree one at the
    16	chosen points.  This file supplies that arithmetic bridge from the actual section certificate,
    17	rather than adding `residueDeg = 1` as an unrelated existential field.  The relative specialization
    18	is the exact point produced by `Over.rationalPointBaseChange`.

    35	/-! ## Sections have residue degree one -/
    36	
    37	theorem residueDeg_one_of_section
    38	    {K : Type u} [Field K]
    39	    {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of K))}
    40	    {e : Spec (CommRingCat.of K) ⟶ X.left}
    41	    (he : e ≫ X.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (CommRingCat.of K)))
    42	    {x : X.left}
    43	    (hx : e.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) = x) :
    44	    X.left.residueDeg K x = 1 := by
    45	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) := stalkAlgebra X.hom x
    46	  have h := bijective_algebraMap_residueField_of_section X he hx
    47	  have hmap :
    48	      algebraMap K (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)) =
    49	        X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x := by
    50	    ext c
    51	    rw [IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply K (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
    52	      (IsLocalRing.ResidueField (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)),
    53	      IsLocalRing.ResidueField.algebraMap_eq, Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap,
    54	      algebraMap_overStalkAlgebra]
    55	    simp [stalkStructureHom, Scheme.overAlgebraMap]
    56	    rfl
    57	  letI : Algebra K (X.left.residueField x) :=
    58	    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x).toAlgebra
    59	  unfold Scheme.residueDeg
    60	  change Module.finrank K (X.left.residueField x) = 1
    61	  apply Module.finrank_of_bijective_algebraMap
    62	  change Function.Bijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap K x)
    63	  rw [← hmap]
    64	  exact h

    66	/-! ## The base-changed rational point is such a section -/
    67	
    68	theorem residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange
    69	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
    70	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    71	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
    72	    (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
    73	    (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))) :
    74	    ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L
    75	      ((Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L)) = 1 := by
    76	  apply residueDeg_one_of_section
    77	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k L)).left)
    78	    (e := Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp)
    79	  · exact Over.rationalPointBaseChange_snd C L p hp
    80	  · rfl
    81	
    82	/-- The graph point of a field-valued point has residue degree one. -/
    83	theorem residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint
    84	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    85	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
    86	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    87	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
    88	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
    89	    (C ⊗ overSpec k K).left.residueDeg K (Over.graphPoint C t) = 1 := by
    90	  exact residueDeg_one_of_section
    91	    (X := Over.mk (snd C (overSpec k K)).left)
    92	    (e := (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left)
    93	    (by
    94	      exact congrArg (fun q : overSpec k K ⟶ overSpec k K => q.left)
    95	        (Over.sectionOfPoint_snd t))
    96	    (by
    97	      change (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint K) =
    98	        (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base default
    99	      exact congrArg (Over.sectionOfPoint t).left.base
   100	        (Subsingleton.elim _ _))
   101	
   102	/-- The graph presentation has multiplicity one at its graph point.
   103	
   104	`presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations` initially records the multiplicity as an order.
   105	The graph class and its residue field both have degree one, so the degree formula forces that
   106	order to be one.  This is the pointwise input for finite-support class descent below. -/
   107	theorem graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single
   108	    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   109	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   110	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   111	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   112	    (t : overSpec k K ⟶ C) :
   113	    Over.graphPicClass C t =
   114	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K
   115	        (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single (graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t) 1) := by
   116	  let hx := graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C t
   117	  let a : ℤ :=
   118	    Multiplicative.toAdd
   119	      (Scheme.ordZ ((C ⊗ overSpec k K).left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of K))
   120	        hx ((Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation.elem (Over.graphPoint C t)))
   121	  have hsingle :
   122	      Scheme.presentationDivisor K (Over.graphLocalEquations C t).presentation =
   123	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a := by
   124	    exact presentationDivisor_graphLocalEquations C t
   125	  have hclass :
   126	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass K (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx a) =
   127	        Over.graphPicClass C t := by
   128	    rw [← hsingle, Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_presentationDivisor K,
   129	      Scheme.LocalEquations.presentation_picClass]
   130	    rfl
   131	  have hdeg := classDeg_graphPicClass C t
   132	  rw [← hclass, classDeg_picClass, Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg_single'] at hdeg
   133	  rw [residueDeg_one_of_graphPoint C t, Nat.cast_one, mul_one] at hdeg
   134	  rw [hdeg] at hclass
   135	  exact hclass.symm

   137	/-! ## Image-set packaging -/
   138	
   139	theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChange_image
   140	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   141	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   142	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   143	    (P : Set (relCurve C L))
   144	    (hP : ∀ x ∈ P, ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
   145	      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   146	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x) :
   147	    ∀ x ∈ P, (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
   148	  intro x hx
   149	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hP x hx
   150	  rw [← hpx]
   151	  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp

   153	/-! ## The dense point image used by the drop oracle -/
   154	
   155	/-- The points obtained by base-changing actual `k`-rational sections of `C` to `L`.
   156	
   157	The section certificate is retained in the membership predicate, so later consumers can recover
   158	the base point and its exact residue-degree proof.  This is deliberately an image set, rather
   159	than an existential carrier unrelated to the chosen curve and extension. -/
   160	def rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   161	    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   162	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] : Set (relCurve C L) :=
   163	  {x | ∃ (p : Spec (.of k) ⟶ C.left)
   164	      (hp : p ≫ C.hom = 𝟙 (Spec (.of k))),
   165	      (Over.rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp).base
   166	        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint L) = x}
   167	
   168	/-- Base-changed `k`-rational points are dense over a separably closed base. -/
   169	theorem dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   170	    {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
   171	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   172	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   173	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsIntegral C.left]
   174	    (U : (relCurve C L).Opens)
   175	    (hU : (U : Set (relCurve C L)).Nonempty) :
   176	    (rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L ∩ U).Nonempty := by
   177	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hmem⟩ := Over.dense_baseChange_rationalPoints C L U hU
   178	  exact ⟨_, ⟨⟨p, hp, rfl⟩, hmem⟩⟩
   179	
   180	/-- Every point in the dense image has residue degree one, by its retained section certificate. -/
   181	theorem residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage'
   182	    {k : Type u} [Field k]
   183	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   184	    (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L] :
   185	    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
   186	      (relCurve C L).residueDeg L x = 1 := by
   187	  intro x hx
   188	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
   189	  rw [← hpx]
   190	  exact residueDeg_one_of_rationalPointBaseChange C L p hp

   192	/-! ## Class descent for divisors supported on the rational-point image -/
   193	
   194	/-- Every point in the rational-point image is non-generic.  The retained section certificate
   195	identifies it with an actual graph point, where `graphPoint_ne_genericPoint` applies. -/
   196	theorem ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   197	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   198	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   199	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   200	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] :
   201	    ∀ x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L,
   202	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left := by
   203	  intro x hx
   204	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hx
   205	  rw [← hpx]
   206	  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
   207	    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
   208	    exact hp)
   209	  change Over.graphPoint C
   210	      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) ≠
   211	        genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left
   212	  exact graphPoint_ne_genericPoint C _
   213	
   214	/-- The one-point divisor at a base-changed rational point is the base change of a class on the
   215	base curve.  This is deliberately a class statement: no pullback operation on Weil divisors is
   216	needed. -/
   217	theorem exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   218	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   219	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   220	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   221	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   222	    (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   223	    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   224	    (hmem : x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   225	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   226	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single hx 1) =
   227	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   228	  obtain ⟨p, hp, hpx⟩ := hmem
   229	  let q : overSpec k k ⟶ C := Over.homMk p (by
   230	    rw [overSpec_self_hom]
   231	    exact hp)
   232	  change Over.graphPoint C
   233	      (Over.overSpecMap (Algebra.ofId k L) ≫ q) = x at hpx
   234	  subst x
   235	  refine ⟨Over.graphPicClass C q, ?_⟩
   236	  rw [← graphPicClass_eq_picClass_single C]
   237	  exact graphPicClass_base_of_field C L q
   238	
   239	/-- A divisor whose finite support consists of base-changed rational points has a Picard class
   240	defined over the base field.
   241	
   242	The proof folds the pointwise graph-class identity over the divisor's `Finsupp` support.  It
   243	works for arbitrary integer multiplicities; effectivity and the prescribed drop degree are
   244	orthogonal hypotheses used by the greedy reduction, not by class descent. -/
   245	theorem exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   246	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   247	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   248	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   249	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   250	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   251	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   252	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   253	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   254	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   255	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   256	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   257	  suffices hmain : ∀ f : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   258	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left} →₀ ℤ,
   259	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   260	        (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   261	        coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) →
   262	      ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   263	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L f =
   264	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c from hmain S hsupp
   265	  intro f
   266	  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
   267	  | zero =>
   268	      intro _
   269	      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
   270	      change Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   271	        (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor) =
   272	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) 1
   273	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, map_one]
   274	      rfl
   275	  | single_add p b f hpf hb ih =>
   276	      intro hsupport
   277	      have hfp : f p = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hpf
   278	      have hpMem : p.1 ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   279	        apply hsupport p.1 p.2
   280	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) p ≠ 0
   281	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, hfp, add_zero]
   282	        exact hb
   283	      have hfSupport : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   284	          (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   285	          coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   286	        intro x hx hfx
   287	        apply hsupport x hx
   288	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) ⟨x, hx⟩ ≠ 0
   289	        have hxp : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {z : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   290	            z ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ≠ p := by
   291	          intro heq
   292	          subst p
   293	          exact hfx hfp
   294	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxp, zero_add]
   295	        exact hfx
   296	      obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ :=
   297	        exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   298	          C p.1 p.2 hpMem
   299	      have key : ∀ D : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor,
   300	          (∃ cf : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   301	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L D =
   302	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) cf) →
   303	          ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   304	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   305	              (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single p.2 b + D) =
   306	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   307	        intro D hD
   308	        obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hD
   309	        refine ⟨cp ^ b * cf, ?_⟩
   310	        unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hcp hcf ⊢
   311	        rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   312	          ← Scheme.picClass_single_zpow L p.2 b, hcp, hcf, map_mul, map_zpow]
   313	      exact key f (ih hfSupport)
   314	
   315	/-- Exact discharge of `SepClosedTranslatedDropData.baseSubtraction` for the rational-point
   316	image.  The descended class is re-presented by an actual base-field divisor `Z`; at exponent
   317	zero, the inverse of `chartTwistClass C 0 Z` is precisely `picClass k Z`. -/
   318	theorem exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   319	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   320	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   321	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   322	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   323	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   324	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   325	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   326	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   327	    ∃ Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor,
   328	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   329	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   330	          ((chartTwistClass C 0 Z)⁻¹) := by
   331	  obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ :=
   332	    exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C S hsupp
   333	  obtain ⟨Z, hZ⟩ := Scheme.CurveDivisor.exists_picClass_eq k c
   334	  refine ⟨Z, ?_⟩
   335	  rw [hc]
   336	  apply congrArg
   337	  simp only [chartTwistClass, pow_zero, one_mul]
   338	  rw [hZ]
   339	  exact (inv_inv c).symm

   343	section DropPackage
   344	
   345	variable {k : Type u} [Field k] [IsSepClosed k]
   346	variable {C : Over (Spec (.of k))}
   347	variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   348	  [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   349	variable {K L : Type u} [Field K] [Algebra k K]
   350	  [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
   351	  [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
   352	
   353	/-- Build the translated-drop package using the actual dense image of base-field rational
   354	points.  Density, non-genericity, residue degree one, and the base-subtraction class identity
   355	are derived here; only the lambda-tied positive-twist divisor and its degree/vanishing data
   356	remain inputs. -/
   357	noncomputable def sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   358	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   359	    (m : ℕ)
   360	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   361	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
   362	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   363	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   364	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   365	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   366	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   367	    (excess : ℕ)
   368	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   369	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   370	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   371	    SepClosedTranslatedDropData (C := C) (L := L) μ where
   372	  m := m
   373	  M₀ := M₀
   374	  hM₀ := hM₀
   375	  W₀ := W₀
   376	  hW₀ := hW₀
   377	  genusValue := genus C
   378	  excess := excess
   379	  hχ := chi_moduleKSheaf C
   380	  hdeg := hdeg
   381	  h1 := h1
   382	  P := rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   383	  hdense := dense_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L
   384	  hPcl := ne_genericPoint_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C
   385	  hPdeg := residueDeg_one_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage' C L
   386	  baseSubtraction := by
   387	    intro S _ _ hsupp
   388	    exact exists_baseSubtraction_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage C S hsupp
   389	
   390	/-- Immediate lambda-tied consumer of the rational-point-image package.
   391	
   392	The result contains the effective subtraction divisor, a base-field translating divisor,
   393	`h⁰ = 1`, preservation of `H¹ = 0`, the class-level base-change identity, and the existing
   394	`IsSplitWitness` for `μ` translated by that specific base-field class. -/
   395	theorem exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult_of_rationalPointImage
   396	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K))
   397	    (m : ℕ)
   398	    (M₀ : (relCurve C L).CechPic)
   399	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ) =
   400	      PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   401	    (W₀ : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   402	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀ =
   403	      M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L)
   404	        (chartTwistClass C m (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)))
   405	    (excess : ℕ)
   406	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (genus C : ℤ) + excess)
   407	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   408	      ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1)) :
   409	    Nonempty (SepClosedTranslatedDropResult (C := C) (L := L) μ
   410	      (sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   411	        μ m M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ excess hdeg h1)) := by
   412	  exact exists_sepClosedTranslatedDropResult μ
   413	    (sepClosedTranslatedDropDataOfRationalPointImage
   414	      μ m M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ excess hdeg h1)
   415	
   416	end DropPackage

    11	# B-5, the fibre step: the greedy drop RUN at the splitting field, as a `chartLocus` witness
    12	
    13	**Title corrected (issue I-0615): this file is steps 4 and 5, not "4–6".**  Step 6 — feeding the
    14	drop's output `Σ` back as the chart index — is NOT here and is not discharged anywhere; see the
    15	DEFECT section of `Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageTest.lean`, which explains why the drop stage and the
    16	index stage carry different `Z`.  The original "4–6" wording is what that retraction corrects.
    17	
    18	`w4-datb` §1.2 steps 4–5 happen entirely on the curve over the splitting field `L`.  This file
    19	runs them and hands the result to `Picard/Pic0ChartTwistSplit.lean`'s introduction rule, so
    20	that what comes out is membership of `chartLocus`.
    21	
    22	## The statement, and what is a hypothesis rather than a construction
    23	
    24	`exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop` takes:
    25	
    26	* the presentation of the *twisted* fibre class over `L` by a Čech class `M`
    27	  (`hM` — supplied at step 1 by `picEtAffineEquiv_map_chartTwistFactor_eq_unit`);
    28	* a divisor `W₀` in that class with vanishing `H¹` and degree `g + e`
    29	  (`hdeg`/`h1` — supplied at step 4: the class's degree is computed by
    30	  `Picard/Pic0ChartCoverageDegree.lean`, and the vanishing comes from the fibre's OWN
    31	  vanishing bound, which is where step 3's per-fibre `m` is spent);
    32	* the admissible point oracle at `L` (`hdense`/`hPcl`/`hPdeg` — supplied at step 5 by
    33	  `Curve/SepPointsDense.lean`'s density keystone at the base-changed `K_s`-points).
    34	
    35	and produces an `S ≥ 0` of degree `e`, supported in the oracle, with `h⁰(W₀ − S) = 1`,
    36	`h¹ = 0`, together with `IsSplitWitness` at the twisted class.
    37	
    38	**What is deliberately a hypothesis:** the *existence* of `W₀` of the right degree with
    39	`h¹ = 0`.  That is DAT-0a at the fibre field, and per `w4-datb` §0.2.2 (the I-0204 discipline)
    40	its bound `b_L` is a **per-fibre** constant that provably does not transport from `k` — so it
    41	must be chosen at `L`, inside the coverage proof, against `L`'s own instance.  Threading it as
    42	a hypothesis here keeps that choice visible instead of burying it: a caller who cannot produce
    43	`W₀` has not yet done step 3.
    44	
    45	**Why the `h⁰ = 1` conclusion is carried even though `IsSplitWitness` does not ask for it:**
    46	the witness predicate asks only for vanishing `H¹` (documented at `IsSplitWitness`; the
    47	worksheets' "effective degree-`g` witness with `h¹ = 0`" is stronger than what the tree's
    48	predicates state).  But `h⁰ = 1` is what DAT-C's normalization and GAP-2's uniqueness need, and
    49	it is free here — the drop produces it.  Dropping it from the conclusion would force a later
    50	lane to re-run the induction.
    51	
    52	## Main declarations
    53	
    54	* `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isSplitWitness_of_drop` — **the fibre step of B-5**: the greedy drop
    55	  at `L`, packaged as `IsSplitWitness` of the twisted class plus the `h⁰ = 1` normalization.
    56	-/

    81	/-! ## The fibre step -/
    82	
    83	variable (C) in
    84	/-- **B-5's fibre step** (`w4-datb` §1.2 steps 4–5, run at the splitting field; **not** step 6 —
    85	see the header correction and issue I-0615).
    86	
    87	Given the twisted fibre class presented over `L` by `M`, a divisor `W₀` in `M` of degree
    88	`g + e` with vanishing `H¹`, and an admissible point oracle `P` on the `L`-curve, the greedy
    89	drop produces `S` of degree `e` supported in `P` with `h⁰(W₀ − S) = 1` and `h¹(W₀ − S) = 0`;
    90	and the class of `W₀` itself already certifies `IsSplitWitness` of the twisted class.

    92	The two conclusions serve different consumers, which is why both are returned: the
    93	`IsSplitWitness` half is `chartLocus` membership (`w4-datb` §1.2's target), while the

   104	`h⁰ = 1` — i.e. the chart map's injectivity, not its coverage. -/

   106	    (μ : picEt C (overSpec k K)) (m : ℕ) (Z : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CurveDivisor)
   107	    {L : Type u} [Field L] [Algebra k L] [Algebra K L] [IsScalarTower k K L]
   108	    [Module.Finite K L] [Algebra.IsSeparable K L]
   109	    (g e : ℕ) (hχ : Sheaf.chi (C.left.moduleKSheaf k) = 1 - (g : ℤ))

   111	    (hM₀ : PicEtAff.map C L (picEtAffineEquiv C K μ)
   112	      = PicEtAff.unit C L (relPicMk C (overSpec k L) M₀))
   113	    (W₀ : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor)
   114	    (hW₀ : Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L W₀
   115	      = M₀ * Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) (chartTwistClass C m Z))
   116	    (hdeg : Scheme.CurveDivisor.deg L W₀ = (g : ℤ) + e)
   117	    (h1 : Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L W₀) 1))
   118	    (P : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left))
   119	    (hdense : ∀ U : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).Opens,
   120	      (U : Set ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)).Nonempty → (P ∩ U).Nonempty)
   121	    (hPcl : ∀ x ∈ P, x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left))
   122	    (hPdeg : ∀ x ∈ P, ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).residueDeg L x = 1) :
   123	    IsSplitWitness C (μ * thetaFamily C (chartTwistClass C m Z) (overSpec k K))
   124	      ∧ ∃ S : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left).CurveDivisor, 0 ≤ S ∧

   126	        (∀ (x : ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left))
   127	          (hx : x ≠ genericPoint ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)),
   128	          coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ P) ∧
   129	        Sheaf.h0 ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (W₀ - S)) = 1 ∧
   130	        Subsingleton (Sheaf.HModule
   131	          ((C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.divisorSheaf L (W₀ - S)) 1) := by
   132	  refine ⟨isSplitWitness_of_witness_twistClass C μ m Z M₀ hM₀ W₀ hW₀ h1, ?_⟩
   133	  -- the χ-value at the fibre field, transported from `k` (genus is base-field invariant)
   134	  -- The instance pack of `BaseChangeInstances` is keyed to the PRODUCT spelling
   135	  -- `(C ⊗ overSpec k L).left`, not to the `relCurve` alias, so `chi_relCurve_baseField`'s
   136	  -- `relCurve`-spelled binders do not synthesise without these three re-keyings.

   138	  haveI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
   139	    instSmoothOfRelativeDimensionBaseChange C L
   140	  haveI : QuasiCompact (relCurve C L ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of L)) :=
   141	    instQuasiCompactBaseChange C L
   142	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 0) :=
   143	    instModuleFiniteHModuleZeroBaseChange C L
   144	  haveI : Module.Finite L (Sheaf.HModule ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) 1) :=
   145	    instModuleFiniteHModuleOneBaseChange C L
   146	  have hχL : Sheaf.chi ((relCurve C L).moduleKSheaf L) = 1 - (g : ℤ) :=
   147	    chi_relCurve_baseField C L g hχ
   148	  exact exists_effective_sub_h0_eq_one (K := L) g hχL P hdense hPcl hPdeg W₀ e hdeg h1

   208	    exact hp)
   209	  change Over.graphPoint C

   239	/-- A divisor whose finite support consists of base-changed rational points has a Picard class
   240	defined over the base field.
   241	
   242	The proof folds the pointwise graph-class identity over the divisor's `Finsupp` support.  It
   243	works for arbitrary integer multiplicities; effectivity and the prescribed drop degree are
   244	orthogonal hypotheses used by the greedy reduction, not by class descent. -/
   245	theorem exists_baseClass_of_supported_on_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   246	    {k L : Type u} [Field k] [Field L] [Algebra k L]
   247	    (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
   248	    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
   249	    [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom]
   250	    (S : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor)
   251	    (hsupp : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   252	      (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   253	      coeffAt hx S ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) :
   254	    ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   255	      Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L S =
   256	        Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   257	  suffices hmain : ∀ f : {x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   258	      x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left} →₀ ℤ,
   259	      (∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   260	        (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   261	        coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L) →
   262	      ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   263	        Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L f =
   264	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c from hmain S hsupp
   265	  intro f
   266	  induction f using Finsupp.induction with
   267	  | zero =>
   268	      intro _
   269	      refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
   270	      change Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   271	        (0 : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor) =
   272	          Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) 1
   273	      rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_zero, map_one]
   274	      rfl
   275	  | single_add p b f hpf hb ih =>
   276	      intro hsupport
   277	      have hfp : f p = 0 := Finsupp.notMem_support_iff.mp hpf
   278	      have hpMem : p.1 ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   279	        apply hsupport p.1 p.2
   280	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) p ≠ 0
   281	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_same, hfp, add_zero]
   282	        exact hb
   283	      have hfSupport : ∀ (x : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left)
   284	          (hx : x ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left),
   285	          coeffAt hx f ≠ 0 → x ∈ rationalPointBaseChangeImage C L := by
   286	        intro x hx hfx
   287	        apply hsupport x hx
   288	        change (Finsupp.single p b + f) ⟨x, hx⟩ ≠ 0
   289	        have hxp : (⟨x, hx⟩ : {z : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left //
   290	            z ≠ genericPoint (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left}) ≠ p := by
   291	          intro heq
   292	          subst p
   293	          exact hfx hfp
   294	        rw [Finsupp.add_apply, Finsupp.single_eq_of_ne hxp, zero_add]
   295	        exact hfx
   296	      obtain ⟨cp, hcp⟩ :=
   297	        exists_baseClass_picClass_single_of_mem_rationalPointBaseChangeImage
   298	          C p.1 p.2 hpMem
   299	      have key : ∀ D : (C ⊗ overSpec k L).left.CurveDivisor,
   300	          (∃ cf : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   301	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L D =
   302	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) cf) →
   303	          ∃ c : (C ⊗ overSpec k k).left.CechPic,
   304	            Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass L
   305	              (Scheme.CurveDivisor.single p.2 b + D) =
   306	              Scheme.CechPic.map (relCurveMap C k L) c := by
   307	        intro D hD
   308	        obtain ⟨cf, hcf⟩ := hD
   309	        refine ⟨cp ^ b * cf, ?_⟩
   310	        unfold relCurveMap relCurve at hcp hcf ⊢
   311	        rw [Scheme.CurveDivisor.picClass_add,
   312	          ← Scheme.picClass_single_zpow L p.2 b, hcp, hcf, map_mul, map_zpow]
   313	      exact key f (ih hfSupport)
